title: Sarah Collins
gist: This is an author archive/index page for Prospect Assistant Editor Sarah Collins, not a standalone article — it lists her bio and headlines spanning EU migration politics and her personal 'Mindful life' mental-health column, with no article body to analyze.

insights.claim: Sarah Collins is Prospect's Assistant Editor and also writes a first-person 'Mindful life' column on mental health topics including grief, depression and OCD.
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine
insights.so_what: Shows Prospect blends staff editorial roles with confessional personal-essay content under the same byline, relevant to reading the outlet's 'Lives' vertical as memoir rather than reportage.
insights.quote: Sarah Collins is Assistant Editor at Prospect

insights.claim: One of Collins's listed headlines is 'Why I should never have used ChatGPT as an OCD therapist,' a first-person cautionary piece about using an AI chatbot for mental-health self-treatment.
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine
insights.so_what: Flags a recurring media narrative around risks of using consumer AI chatbots as informal therapy, worth tracking as a public-perception headwind for AI companion/wellness use cases; only the headline is available here, not the article text.

insights.claim: Collins also covers EU/UK politics, including a piece on Spain's progressive migration policy in the wake of the Ceuta crisis and commentary on Andy Burnham.
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine
insights.so_what: Indicates the same byline spans hard EU migration policy and personal essay, useful context when weighing the authority behind any single Collins piece.
